LALIGA FANTASY is the only official Soccer manager game, with live general ranking and scores based on official LALIGA results and statistics.

Conquer LALIGA and be the best Fantasy Soccer manager there is!


Play in Public League Divisions:

Public Leagues include divisions that you can access based on your performance from last season. If you are a new user, you will start from the last division and move up based on your results.

True Stats live scores:

Player scoring works based on the real stats of matches - follow LALIGA live while having fun with LALIGA's only official fantasy manager!

What are you waiting for? Create a league of your own and compete with your friends! Become a coach, manage your Soccer club by signing LALIGA stars... And show who is the best Soccer manager!




How it works:

1. Register via the app, get a team of 14 players and a transfer budget of 100 million.
2. Manage your lineup, formations and game systems. Try new tactics and Soccer lineups until you find your ideal eleven.
3. Bid for Soccer players in the transfer market, create a Dream Team and become the best manager there is.
4. Invite friends to play and compete against them in Fantasy Leagues.

Manage your budget, sign new Soccer stars from LALIGA and play with your friends as a true "Mister" from LALIGA.

Join the Fantasy family and millions of other players around the world and begin your journey to become the best LALIGA Soccer manager there is!
